name: packed-v4-on-v3-replay

base_results.finding: collapse stayed with physical validator-4 host after v3/v4 identity swap

hypothesis: The current four-physical-host topology is invalid for performance work because physical validator-4 is pathological. Running validator-4 as a second isolated instance on physical validator-3, while stopping physical validator-4 and driving ingress only through validators 2/3, should recover item251-class throughput without changing protocol code.
planned_commands: cd chain/deploy/ansible && KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=$(grep -m1 '^KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=' /tmp/and-live-testnet/validator-1.env | cut -d= -f2-) .venv/bin/ansible -i inventory/260-packed-v4-on-v3.yml kombat_retired_testnet -m shell -a 'systemctl stop kombat-chain-ingress6 kombat-chain-ingress5 kombat-chain-ingress4 kombat-chain-ingress3 kombat-chain-ingress2 kombat-chain-ingress kombat-chain || true'

cd chain/deploy/ansible && KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=$(grep -m1 '^KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=' /tmp/and-live-testnet/validator-1.env | cut -d= -f2-) KOMBAT_BINARY_PATH=/tmp/kombat_chain-live-dd022982 .venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/260-packed-v4-on-v3.yml playbooks/deploy.yml

cd chain/deploy/ansible && KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=$(grep -m1 '^KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=' /tmp/and-live-testnet/validator-1.env | cut -d= -f2-) KOMBAT_BINARY_PATH=/tmp/kombat_chain-live-dd022982 .venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/260-packed-v4-on-v3.yml playbooks/verify.yml

cd chain/deploy/ansible && KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=$(grep -m1 '^KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=' /tmp/and-live-testnet/validator-1.env | cut -d= -f2-) .venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/260-packed-v4-on-v3.yml playbooks/reset_state.yml

LOADTEST_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/and-live-260-packed-v4-on-v3-v2v3-12ingress-100k-60s LOADTEST_DRAIN_SECS=30 LOADTEST_BATCH_SIZE=8 LOADTEST_PIPELINE_DEPTH=1 LOADTEST_FAIL_ON_ERRORS=1 LOADTEST_VALIDATOR_NAMES='validator-2 validator-3' LOADTEST_ENDPOINT_PORTS='8645 8646 8647 8648 8649 8650' bash chain/scripts/loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh /tmp/and-live-testnet-260-packed 32 100000 60
pre_run_deploy_fixes: Set ansible_user=root at all.vars scope in the packed inventory so retired physical validator-4 commands use root instead of the local username.

Changed deploy.yml service-user creation to use a stable service-user home instead of the per-instance state dir, so a second validator instance does not try to usermod the already-running and-chain user.

result.classification: Packed topology removed the physical validator-4 substrate failure and preserved correctness/drain, but did not recover item251 green TPS. The new bottleneck is delivered ingress/loadgen capacity on the two driven physical hosts: 100k offered produced only 38.6k measured RPS and all accepted work committed.

current_topology: Packed topology left active after the run because it is correct and materially better than the current four-physical-host replay, though still not green.
rollback: To return to the default topology, stop kombat-chain-v4 and extra ingress4-6 services on validators 2/3, then redeploy inventory/testnet.yml and wipe state.
